80C_INVEST.description: Deductions for investments in specified instruments like ELSS, PPF, and Life Insurance premiums.
80C_INVEST.clause: Section 80C of the Income Tax Act 1961 allows a deduction of up to ₹1.5 Lakh.

80D_HEALTH.description: Deductions for health insurance premiums for self, spouse, children, and parents.
80D_HEALTH.clause: Section 80D allows deductions for medical insurance premiums up to ₹25,000 (Self) and additional ₹50,000 (Senior Parents).

80CCD_NPS.description: Additional deductions for contributions to the National Pension System.
80CCD_NPS.clause: Section 80CCD(1B) provides an exclusive deduction of ₹50,000 for NPS contributions.

SALARY.description: Remuneration from employment, including allowances and standard deductions.
SALARY.clause: Income from salaries is taxed as per the slab rates after a standard deduction of ₹50,000.

BUSINESS_REV.description: Revenue generated from business operations or professional services.
BUSINESS_REV.clause: Business revenue is subject to taxation under Section 28 (Profits and Gains of Business or Profession).
